global.title: Meet Arina Agri
global.intro: This short guide introduces the main dashboard areas before you start recording farm activity.

dashboard.title: Track summaries from Dashboard
dashboard.body: Dashboard shows important conditions such as finance, weather, stock, and recent activity so you can quickly see what needs attention today.

finance.title: Record cash flow in Finance
finance.body: Use Finance to record income and expenses, review cost categories, and export reports when needed.

operations.title: Manage stock and work schedules
operations.body: Stock tracks harvest batches and movements. Calendar helps plan fertilizing, spraying, irrigation, and harvest work.

insights.title: Make decisions with information
insights.body: Weather provides forecasts and alerts, Market News tracks market updates, and AI Chat helps find chili disease and cultivation references.

settings.title: Set profile and preferences
settings.body: Open Settings to update your profile, language, theme, and notification contact. You can reopen this guide from the Guide button.

finance.title: Start using Finance
finance.intro: This page records transactions and helps you read farm cash-flow health.

overview.title: Read the summary first
overview.body: Check total income, expenses, and estimated net profit to understand the current month.

record.title: Record the first transaction
record.body: Use Record Transaction to enter date, category, amount, and a short note so reports stay tidy.

report.title: Export when reporting is needed
report.body: Use Excel export or AI reports once transaction data is complete enough to share or evaluate.

stock.title: Start using Stock
stock.intro: Stock helps track harvest from inbound batch to outbound movement.

overview.title: Review ready stock
overview.body: Summary cards show available stock, sold stock, estimated value, and batches that need priority.

batch.title: Input harvest batches
batch.body: Add a batch for every harvest with date, grade, weight, storage location, and expiry estimate.

mutation.title: Record stock out
mutation.body: When stock is sold or shipped, record outbound movement so remaining weight and shipping history stay accurate.

weather.title: Start using Weather
weather.intro: Weather helps read farm conditions and prepare daily alerts.

overview.title: Check current weather
overview.body: Use the weather card and forecast to adjust fertilizing, spraying, or irrigation schedules.

location.title: Choose farm location
location.body: Enable GPS or search manually so the BMKG forecast matches your working area.

notification.title: Enable important notifications
notification.body: Save WhatsApp or Telegram contact details to receive reminders and extreme weather alerts.

market.title: Start using Market News
market.intro: Market News helps follow relevant market and agriculture updates.

overview.title: Read the latest updates
overview.body: Start from the latest article list to follow price trends, weather, policy, and farming tips.

categories.title: Use categories
categories.body: Category filters help you focus on prices, market, weather, policy, or cultivation tips.

prices.title: Watch price signals
prices.body: When available, use the price map and chart to compare market conditions before selling harvest.

encyclopedia.title: Start using AI Chat
encyclopedia.intro: AI Chat helps answer questions about chili, diseases, pests, and cultivation.

overview.title: Start with a simple question
overview.body: Ask about symptoms, cultivation schedules, or pest handling with short and clear wording.

ask.title: Add farm context
ask.body: Include plant age, weather, symptoms, and actions already tried so the answer is more useful.

reference.title: Use quick references
reference.body: Read disease cards to compare common symptoms before making field decisions.

calendar.title: Start using Calendar
calendar.intro: Calendar helps plan and remember recurring farm activities.

overview.title: Review upcoming work
overview.body: The upcoming schedule area shows near-term activities so daily work is easier to prioritize.

schedule.title: Add an activity schedule
schedule.body: Record title, activity type, date, time, and notes so the team knows what work needs doing.

reminder.title: Use it as a work reminder
reminder.body: Add fertilizing, spraying, irrigation, and harvest activities to keep farm routines consistent.

settings.title: Start using Settings
settings.intro: Settings stores appearance preferences, profile details, contacts, and system information.

overview.title: Know the settings tabs
overview.body: Use Profile, General, Notifications, and System Info tabs based on what you need to change.

profile.title: Complete your profile
profile.body: Make sure name, main commodity, and notification contact are correct so the app feels more personal.

preferences.title: Adjust the interface
preferences.body: Choose the language and theme that feel most comfortable on desktop or mobile.

quickActions.title: Harvest Stock Management
quickActions.description: Track stock and the latest harvest batches.

search.helper: Type a village, district, or city name, then choose a suggested area.
search.minChars: Type at least 3 characters to show suggestions.

emptyWeather.title: No weather data yet
emptyWeather.subtitle: Enable GPS or enter a manual location to get the latest weather data.

errors.loadBmkg: Failed to load BMKG weather data.

whatsapp.title: Weather Notifications
whatsapp.note: Choose your notification platform first, then save the corresponding contact. WhatsApp uses a phone number, while Telegram uses your bot chat ID or username.
whatsapp.phoneHelper: Use international format without the + sign, e.g., 6281234567890.
whatsapp.telegramHelper: Use Telegram chat ID or username according to your bot.
whatsapp.defaultScheduleMessage: Daily reminder: check today's weather conditions and work plan.
whatsapp.scheduleSub: Set the time for automatic notification delivery every day.
whatsapp.scheduleSuccess: Schedule saved successfully. Notifications will be sent daily at the selected time.
whatsapp.scheduleNoContact: Target contact must be saved first in weather notifications.
tutorialSteps: Search for @Arina_Test_28_Bot on Telegram and send /start.
Then click Send Test Message for verification.
Then set the Daily Notification Schedule with Telegram platform and save.

diseases.symptoms: Brown spots on fruit, rotting from tip or middle

diseases.name: Gemini Virus (Yellow)

diseases.symptoms: Holes in leaves, striped brown worms active at night

diseases.symptoms: Sooty mold on leaves, vector for yellow virus
